title: The lantern maker
alt: An experienced lantern maker brushes paste onto a partially covered bamboo lantern frame.
description: An intimate craft portrait combines natural hand contact, fine paper detail and a richly layered workshop.
prompt: An intimate editorial photograph of an older adult East Asian lantern maker in a richly detailed workshop. She sits at a wooden table, holding a partially completed red paper lantern by its bamboo frame with one hand while the other applies paste with a small natural brush. The frame, paper strips and handle connect plausibly; hanging finished lanterns, bamboo slats and warm lamplight surround her. Natural face and hands, visible brush contact and detailed craft textures, no visible writing.
